title: Dasmariñas-general Mariano Alvarez, Carmona Bypass Road, Package A, Carmona, Cavite
description: DASMARIÑAS-GENERAL MARIANO ALVAREZ-CARMONA BYPASS ROAD, PACKAGE A, STA. 44+465 - STA. 44+561, CARMONA, CAVITE
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: Bidders: I.a . Bosque Construction Corporation and Marcbilt Construction, Inc.

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱937.0M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Other road project, 339 past contracts) is ₱588.8M per km. Length read from the title: 96 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Marcbilt Construction, Inc.: 1 of 132 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** The ABC of about 90.0M and the 96 m length match DPWH, but DPWH lists the category as slope protection with structural measures, which may explain the high cost per km and the peer comparison.
**Sources:** confirmed on DPWH API (ABC and stationing match; category differs from the road peer group; PhilGEPS notice not attached) · **Suggested next step:** check the source by hand
